title: Giant flown to a base in Qatar

tellings.quote: and then they they transferred it to Qatar, a base in Qatar.

plain: After US troops captured a giant about 12 feet tall in Afghanistan, its body was transferred to a military base in Qatar, around 2005. Tim Alberino, a documentary maker who tells the Afghanistan giant story, says this second-hand from what he was told. If true, it would mean the body was moved out of the country and kept by the military.
